title: Google Ordered to Pause Data Center Construction in Finland
subtitle: Environmental concerns lead to a temporary halt on major technology projects in the north.

summary.en: Google has been told to stop work on two data center sites in Finland. The Finnish government says the company failed to complete necessary environmental impact assessments before starting construction. Large areas of forest were cleared without proper permission or study. Google admits it did not meet its own standards and has promised to follow local guidance. The incident highlights the pressure on companies to build digital infrastructure quickly.
summary.zh: Google 已被要求停止在芬蘭的兩處資料中心工程。芬蘭政府表示，該公司在動工前未完成必要的環境影響評估。大片森林在未經適當許可或研究的情況下遭到清除。Google 承認未達自身標準，並承諾會遵循當地指導方針。此事件凸顯了企業在快速建設數位基礎設施時所面臨的壓力。

paragraphs.en: Google has been ordered to temporarily stop work on two major data center projects in Finland. The Finnish Licensing and Supervision Authority (LVV) issued the order after finding that the technology company failed to complete required environmental impact assessments before starting construction. An environmental impact assessment — a study that checks how a project might change the local nature and wildlife — is a legal requirement for large building projects in the region.
paragraphs.zh: Google 已被勒令暫時停止在芬蘭的兩項大型資料中心工程。芬蘭許可與監管局（LVV）在發現這家科技公司未能在動工前完成必要的環境影響評估後，發布了這項命令。環境影響評估是一項旨在檢視開發案可能如何改變當地自然環境與野生生態的研究，在該地區，大型建築工程必須依法進行此類評估。

paragraphs.en: The projects in Muhos and Kajaani are part of a massive 13 billion euro investment by Google. This investment aims to build new infrastructure to support the growing global demand for online services. However, the LVV reported that Google had already begun "extensive preparatory measures" at these sites. These actions included cutting down hundreds of hectares of forest, removing topsoil, and building new roads. According to The Guardian, the company cleared 330 hectares of forest in Muhos and nearly 200 hectares in Kajaani without finishing the necessary environmental studies.
paragraphs.zh: 位於穆霍斯（Muhos）與卡亞尼（Kajaani）的這些計畫，是 Google 高達一百三十億歐元投資案的一部分。這項投資旨在建立新的基礎設施，以支援全球對線上服務日益增長的需求。然而，芬蘭許可與監管局指出，Google 已經在這些地點展開了「大規模的準備工作」。這些行動包括砍伐數百公頃的森林、移除表土以及興建新道路。根據《衛報》（The Guardian）報導，該公司在未完成必要環境研究的情況下，已在穆霍斯清除了三百三十公頃的森林，在卡亞尼則清除了近兩百公頃。

paragraphs.en: Tommi Muilu, the head of the environmental department at the LVV, explained that these actions significantly changed the local environment. He noted that identifying and assessing such changes is the main goal of the environmental impact assessment process. The authority has given Google until October 23 to stop these activities. If the company does not follow these instructions, the LVV may take further legal action or issue a fine.
paragraphs.zh: 芬蘭許可與監管局環境部門主管托米·穆伊盧（Tommi Muilu）解釋說，這些行動已顯著改變了當地環境。他指出，識別並評估此類變動正是環境影響評估程序的主要目標。該局已要求 Google 在十月二十三日前停止這些活動。若該公司不遵守指示，當局可能會採取進一步的法律行動或開罰。

paragraphs.en: The Finnish Association for Nature Conservation has been very critical of the situation. Tapani Veistola, the chief operating officer of the association, described the state of the Muhos site as a "sand area" rather than a forest. He suggested that this issue is part of a larger, systemic problem. According to The Guardian, Veistola believes that the "overheated" market for data centers is forcing companies to work as fast as possible. This speed often puts too much pressure on small local governments that may lack the expertise to manage such large projects.
paragraphs.zh: 芬蘭自然保護協會（Finnish Association for Nature Conservation）對此情況提出嚴厲批評。該協會營運長塔帕尼·韋斯托拉（Tapani Veistola）形容穆霍斯的工地現況已非森林，而是一片「沙地」。他認為此問題反映了一個更廣泛的系統性困境。根據《衛報》報導，韋斯托拉認為資料中心市場「過熱」，迫使企業必須以最快速度趕工。這種速度往往對缺乏管理大型開發案專業知識的地方政府造成過大壓力。

paragraphs.en: In response to the order, Google released a statement acknowledging that they had "fallen short of our own high standards." The company said it understands the concerns raised by the authorities and will study the findings from the LVV. Google maintained that it acted in good faith under the Forestry Act, which governs the use of forest land. They also stated that they had conducted nature surveys and taken steps to protect areas of high value. Looking ahead, the company said it is working on plans to improve biodiversity, including a project to plant trees across 130 hectares of land in Muhos.
paragraphs.zh: 針對這項命令，Google 發布聲明承認其「未達自身的高標準」。該公司表示理解當局提出的疑慮，並將研究芬蘭許可與監管局的調查結果。Google 強調，其行為是基於規範林地使用的《林業法》並秉持善意所為。他們並表示已進行自然調查，並採取措施保護高價值區域。展望未來，該公司表示正研擬提升生物多樣性的計畫，包括在穆霍斯一百三十公頃的土地上植樹。

paragraphs.en: This situation highlights the growing tension between the need for digital infrastructure and the protection of natural landscapes. As the world relies more on cloud computing and artificial intelligence, the demand for data centers continues to rise. These facilities require vast amounts of space and energy, often leading companies to look for locations in northern regions where land is available. However, as seen in Finland, this rapid growth can lead to conflicts with local environmental laws and conservation groups.
paragraphs.zh: 此情況凸顯了數位基礎設施需求與保護自然景觀之間日益緊張的關係。隨著全球對雲端運算與人工智慧的依賴加深，對資料中心的需求持續攀升。這些設施需要龐大的空間與能源，往往導致企業轉向土地資源充足的北方地區尋求設點。然而，正如在芬蘭所見，這種快速擴張可能導致與當地環境法規及保育團體的衝突。

paragraphs.en: The environmental impact assessment for the two sites is currently ongoing and is expected to be finished later this year. Until that process is complete, Google must wait to continue its work. The outcome of this case will likely serve as a lesson for other technology companies looking to expand their physical footprint in Europe. It serves as a reminder that even the largest global companies must follow local rules to ensure their growth does not come at the cost of the environment. For now, the focus remains on whether Google can successfully address the concerns of the Finnish authorities and complete the required environmental studies in a way that satisfies both the government and the local community.
paragraphs.zh: 這兩處地點的環境影響評估目前仍在進行中，預計於今年稍晚完成。在該程序結束前，Google 必須暫停施工。此案的結果可能會成為其他計畫在歐洲擴張實體版圖的科技公司的借鏡。這提醒了世人，即使是全球規模最大的企業，也必須遵守當地法規，以確保其成長不會以犧牲環境為代價。目前，焦點仍集中在 Google 能否成功解決芬蘭當局的疑慮，並以令政府與當地社區滿意的方式完成必要的環境研究。

keyTerms.definitionEn: To fail to reach a standard or expectation.
keyTerms.noteZh: 此片語在商業語境中常用，容易誤解為「跌倒」或「變短」。文中：Google released a statement acknowledging that they had "fallen short of our own high standards."

keyTerms.definitionEn: Used to describe a market or economy that is growing too fast and may become unstable.
keyTerms.definitionZh: （市場或經濟）過熱的，指發展過快且可能不穩定。
keyTerms.noteZh: 字面意思是「過熱」，但在商業新聞中指市場競爭過度激烈。文中：Veistola believes that the "overheated" market for data centers is forcing companies to work as fast as possible.

keyTerms.definitionEn: The amount of space or environmental impact that a company or project occupies.
keyTerms.definitionZh: （企業或計畫的）佔地規模或環境影響範圍。
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見指「腳印」，這裡引申為企業擴張的規模。文中：The outcome of this case will likely serve as a lesson for other technology companies looking to expand their physical footprint in Europe.

quiz.question: What specific actions did Google take at the project sites before completing the required environmental impact assessments?

options.A: They built the main data center buildings despite the lack of permits.
options.B: They cleared hundreds of hectares of forest and constructed new roads.
options.C: They installed energy-efficient cooling systems for the servers.
options.D: They purchased additional land from local farmers to expand the project.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。根據文章第二段，Google 在未完成環境影響評估的情況下，已經進行了「廣泛的準備措施」，包括砍伐數百公頃森林、移除表土以及興建新道路。選項 A 錯誤，因為文章僅提到準備工作，未提及建築主體已完成；選項 C 與 D 在文中皆未提及，屬於無中生有的干擾選項。

quiz.question: Based on the article, why might the 'overheated' data center market lead to environmental issues in small regions?

options.A: Small regions are intentionally choosing to ignore environmental laws to attract investment.
options.B: The high demand for data centers makes it impossible for companies to find any land that isn't forested.
options.C: The pressure to build quickly can overwhelm local governments that lack the resources to manage large-scale projects.
options.D: Companies are intentionally avoiding environmental studies to reduce the total cost of their 13 billion euro investment.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。根據文章第四段，Tapani Veistola 指出「過熱」的市場迫使公司快速行動，這種速度對缺乏專業知識來管理大型專案的小型地方政府造成了巨大壓力。選項 A 錯誤，因為文章並未說地方政府故意忽視法律；選項 B 過度推論，文中未提及土地取得的困難性；選項 D 雖然聽起來合理，但文章並未明確指出 Google 是為了省錢而故意規避法律，而是強調了市場壓力與政府監管能力的落差。

quiz.question: In the fourth paragraph, what does the word 'overheated' imply about the data center market?

options.A: The market is growing too quickly and becoming unstable.
options.B: The physical temperature inside data centers is rising too high.
options.C: The market is experiencing a temporary decrease in profitability.
options.D: The market is becoming more strictly regulated by international laws.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 A。在文中，「overheated」一詞用來形容市場發展速度過快，導致壓力過大，這是一種隱喻用法，意指市場過度活躍且缺乏穩定性。選項 B 是對該詞的字面誤解；選項 C 與文意相反，過熱通常代表需求過高而非降低；選項 D 錯誤，文中提到的是地方政府難以應對，而非市場受到更嚴格的國際監管。

quiz.question: What is the primary message of the article regarding Google's data center projects in Finland?

options.A: Google has successfully proven that its data centers will improve local biodiversity.
options.B: The Finnish government is planning to ban all future foreign investments in technology.
options.C: Large-scale infrastructure projects must balance rapid digital expansion with compliance to local environmental regulations.
options.D: The environmental impact assessment process in Finland is too slow and hinders global technological progress.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。文章的核心在於探討數位基礎設施需求與環境保護之間的張力，並強調即便是像 Google 這樣的大型公司，也必須遵守當地法規以確保發展不會以環境為代價。選項 A 錯誤，Google 目前仍在應對環境調查；選項 B 誇大其辭，文中並未提到要禁止外資；選項 D 雖然提到評估過程，但並非文章的主旨，文章強調的是「遵守法規」的必要性而非評估過程本身的快慢。
